notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.30.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v2025.8.30.0
Just a quick patch before the Best Indie Games Fall Showcase!

Added multiple save files

Convoy vehicles now have thin outlines when "thick outlines" is disabled

Elite enemies no longer have thick outlines

Deployable turrets now have 16 sprite directions instead of 8

Removed "refund" upgrade from turrets

Fixed an issue with UI elements moving too quickly at low frame rates

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.26.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/878448214483bdd73da0f857ca7bdb356fd1639f.gif"]

One of the oldest animals currently living, most think Walter long dead - yet the "King of Grove City" still rules from the shadows.
Heroes
Added Walter O'Possum!

Removed "Weighted Dice" upgrade for Chuck, and replaced with "Spoils of War"
Missions
Added the "Convoy" mission type!

Players must destroy a convoy of vehicles circling the map

Added arena modifiers to increase convoy HP, vehicle count, vehicle armor, and vehicle shields
Upgrades
Added the "King Of Grove City" upgrade - First purchase in each shop is free (exclusive to Walter O'Possum)

Added the "Center Mass" upgrade - Weapon has 100% accuracy but can no longer crit

Added the "Homing" upgrade - Projectiles home towards their target

Homing projectiles will ignore enemies other than their target, unless they have pierce
Weapons
Added Carbine

Added Smart Rifle

Added Jammer

Added Tactical Nuke

Added more angles for weapons to be pointing, to match the updated number of player directional sprites

Updated targeting priority for some weapons

Added the "projectile" tag to turrets, increasing the pool of upgrades they can acquire
UI
Fixed an issue where locked weapons on the loadout screen would show their elements

Weapons now show their targeting priority

Weapon stat window is now cropped to fit inside game screen, and automatically scrolls when necessary

Added tooltips to the map generation screen

Fixed an issue with ammo indicators having too little precision when drawing circles

Weapon damage/kill stats are now rounded
Gamepad Controls
Left stick now snaps to nearest button

Right stick now moves cursor freely
Other
Added a warning sound when the mission timer is getting low

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.8.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/b5680173e53c90ff60619487807c043cf4f3ce41.gif"]

Known as "the wrench with a stench," Petals is one of the finest engineers around, yet many find him revolting. Just one of the downsides of being British.
Heroes
Added Petals!
UI
Weapons now show their elemental type in the bottom corner of the weapon plaque

Weapon weight is now shown in the stats section when hovering over them in the armory/loadout screen

Missions now show how many skulls they will award

Fixed an issue with enemy healthbars showing over the flashbang effect

Ammo indicator circle now adjusts precision based on reload time
Misc
Fixed an issue with "New York Reload" not working properly for revolvers and tube weapons

Increased base skulls awarded per mission

Removed max count for turrets, and increased reload time

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.1.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/d54285f79d61fbe87b1f789ccdecf30ebb55628d.gif"]

Heiress apparent to the Badger Mafia, Fyodora forgoes her mother's tact in favor of sheer force - and the cruel temper of a Grovograd winter.


Heroes
Added Fyodora - specializes in shotguns, HP, and frost damage!

Chuck - removed Weakpoint upgrade, added Retail Therapy

Gosling - removed Reverse Speed upgrade, added Weakpoint
Currency Conversion
Added the "Convert Currency" panel to the garage

Allows the player to convert scrap to cash and vice versa
Upgrades
New upgrade: "Celebratory Feast" - increases HP regained on level-up

New upgrade: "Tortoise Shell" - all armor applied to BACK only

New upgrade: "Pacifist" - weapon deals +100% damage, but can no longer kill or deal elemental dmg

New upgrade: "Backhoe" - Deal plow and building damage while reversing

"Fat Reserves": armor effectiveness changed from 0% -> 50%

"Booze Cruise": accuracy penalty changed from 50% -> 25%
Accuracy Rework
Accuracy previously only affected a weapon's spread, which became insignificant once large swarms of enemies appeared

When dealing damage, weapons now have a chance to deal a "glancing blow," which reduces damage by 50%

Glancing blow chance on hit = (1 - Weapon Accuracy)

For example, a weapon with 75% accuracy will deal a glancing blow 25% of the time

Accuracy still affects weapon spread, but shotguns now have a minimum spread amount
Arena Modifiers
New modifier: "Piercing Blows" - Increases enemy armor piercing damage

New modifier: "Special Forces" - increases elite enemy spawn rate

Removed modifiers that spawned specific elite enemies
Visuals
Explosions and shrapnel now create elemental effects

Damage numbers now create more vertical separation between each other to make them more legible

Minimap now shows the location of enemy shield generators

Added a bulldozer animation in the loading screen
Enemies
Driller move speed increased from 1.5 m/s -> 2 m/s

Elite enemies now move 25% faster

Elite enemies now have a chance to spawn at any time, with the spawn rate and max elite count increasing at higher levels
Weapons
Hunting rifle: increased fire rate

Javelin: increased accuracy

Updated projectile sprites for crossbow, explosive crossbow, and javelin
Scrap
Buildings now drop 10% less scrap

Destroying a non-target building now removes 5 seconds from the clock

Armor base scrap cost changed from 10 -> 15

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.18.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/9827d10b6e59b2a4eac6a6098b6fa784f606b9b6.gif"]

None have found a way to kill Bucky yet - no matter how he searches. Tortured by his past, only in a blaze of glory may the "Kamikaze Cockerel" atone.
Heroes
Added Bucky, the Kamikaze Cockerel!

Specializes in explosive weapons


Upgrades
New upgrade: "Stopping Power" - increased weapon knockback

New upgrade: "Retail Therapy" - coins restore HP

Elemental upgrades (e.g. Hailstorm, Short Circuit, etc.) will now only appear if the player has a weapon with the relevant element


Buildings
Added the Hardware Store building type, which drops large amounts of wood


Map Generation
Reworked the map generation algorithm to better distribute special locations (Armory, Black Market, etc.) throughout the map


Visuals
Wood collectibles now travel to the player portrait when collected

Added trail effects for projectiles with elemental upgrades

While in a mission, the cursor will disappear if not moved for 1 second


Enemies
Fixed a bug preventing Shotgunners from spawning

Increased HP for elite enemies

Reduced Hacker frequency


Weapons
Revolvers now reload one bullet at a time (total reload time remains the same)

Shrapnel now travels at a fixed speed instead of being tied to the parent projectile's speed

Fixed an issue with shrapnel playing the parent weapon's sound effect

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.11.0
notes.content:
Garage
Added the "Remove Weapon Upgrades" panel

Spend scrap to remove upgrades from weapons
Upgrades
Projectiles fired from the "Dual Wield" upgrade now start on the opposite side of the bulldozer, instead of the same position as the original projectile

New upgrade: "Refund" - weapon has chance to use no ammo when firing

New upgrade: "Double Tap" - weapon deals extra damage against damaged enemies

New upgrade: "Handicraft" - scrap cost for repairs, armor upgrades, etc. reduced

New upgrade: "Symbiosis" - when a weapon gets a kill, a different weapon gains +1 ammo or speeds up its reload
Visuals
Fixed cockpit and flee sprites for Izumi

Added exhaust smoke that emanates from the dozer

Explosions now create smoke

Scrap and coins now travel to their respective HUD icons when collected 
Enemies
Added the "Flash" status affect that enemies can inflict on the player, which impedes the player's vision when they hit the player

No enemies have it by default yet, but added an arena modifier to give ranged enemies flash, and one to give all enemies flash

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.4.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/e47202d478ce6f2bbf25915fdff077c1f4c63382.gif"]Heroes
Added a new hero, Izumi - Master Of 1,000 Needles

Marvin : Replaced Quick Hands (Heavy) with Jobsite Experience
Enemies
Added the Shotgunner enemy type

Added the Elite Shotgunner enemy type
Difficulty
Adjusted the formula for tier difficulty 

Starting at Tier 2, enemies gain a +50 starting level bonus. This bonus doubles each tier, so Tier 3 -> 100, Tier 4 -> 200, Tier 5 -> 400, etc.

Buildings now gain extra health that scales with arena level
New Upgrades
"Luck" : gives the player a chance to take zero damage when hit

"Hail Storm" : frozen enemies shatter into a burst of projectiles on death

"Poison Barbs" : Deal poison damage when hit by a melee enemy

"Smite" : Shock damage no longer spreads, but instantly deals all of its damage in a small radius

"Up In Smoke" : Fire damage ticks twice as quickly

"Mag Dump" : Upgraded weapon shoots more rapidly while firing continuously

"Extended Bags" : +X ammo (thrown weapons only)

"Guard Up" : While a weapon is reloading, that side gains +10 armor

"New York Reload" : Every 2nd reload is reduced to 0.5 seconds
Garage
Separated repairs and armor upgrades into two different panels, each with an button to access

New system allows for new panels to be added in the future
Visuals
Fixed the sprite for the destroyed bulldozer to have empty cockpit

Added cloud shadows that move along the ground in the arena

Added more sprites for gun smoke

notes.content:
Patch Notes - v2025.6.20.0
Added smoke and spark effects to bullet weapons

Updated RPG sound effect

Updated sound effect for collecting scrap/coins

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.6.18.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v2025.6.18.0

Visuals
Doubled the number of directions the player can face from 8 -> 16

Added a "Thick Outlines" option which can be toggled under Video Options

Added bullet casings that are dropped when a weapon fires/reloads, depending on weapon

Pilot is now shown running from the wreckage after the player is destroyed

Added a small flash effect to bullets when fired
Buildings
Added a system for different random building types

Added one new type of building, the "Bank," which drops Cash instead of Scrap
Upgrades
Added the "Thorns" upgrade, which causes melee enemies to take damage when they hit the player
Other
Debug logs are now written to file. Can be found in %localappdata% -> ProjectGranby -> logs

Fixed an issue with screenshot file names

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.6.12.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v2025.6.12.0
Hovering over a character in the character select screen now shows their primary ability

Hovering over a weapon in the loadout screen or the armory now shows the weapon's stats

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.6.11.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v2025.6.11.0
Added the "Collateral Damage" upgrade, which allows weapons to deal damage to buildings

Added a delay to coins and scrap being attracted to the player, to better show what the player is collecting

Updated game logo
Bug Fixes
Pressing the pause/play button while the options menu is open during a mission will now resume the game

Potentially fixed a bug where the game freezes after generating a new map
